scheme_name: Bank Loan Processing Fee Reimbursement Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category and own/represent any MSE unit.
Loans must be obtained from scheduled commercial banks, non‑banking finance companies (NBFCs), or state finance corporations.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 80% of the bank loan processing fee, capped at ₹1,00,000 (excluding GST and other taxes).
